headline: EasyEquities Restricts Platform Access Following Cybersecurity Incident
summary: South African investment platform EasyEquities restricted access to its platform following a cybersecurity incident, assuring clients that funds remain secure while investigating potential data access.
why: Cybersecurity incidents on retail investment platforms pose operational risks and test customer trust regarding asset security.

impacts.name: EasyEquities
impacts.why: Platform outages and security breaches create immediate operational friction and potential regulatory scrutiny.
